title: The Posterior-Prior Epistemic Gap: When World Model Imagination Fails to Carry Task-Relevant Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.14955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model-based planners that roll out imagined futures assume the transition model faithfully propagates task-relevant signals---a property rarely measured directly. In a single-seed case study of a Recurrent State Space Model world model with active-inference planning in the CARLA driving simulator, we identify a \textbf{posterior-prior gap}---posterior (observation-filtered) states retain obstacle information that imagined rollout states progressively lose: a supervised obstacle probe achieves AUC 0.85 on posterior states, but the same probe applied to imagined prior states shows monotonic decay (AUC 0.85$\rightarrow$0.71 over 15 steps; logit separation drops 57\%). Because the probe is identical, the decay isolates the transition model---not the representation---as the information bottleneck. translated_title: 后验-先验认知鸿沟：当世界模型的想象无法携带任务相关信号时
translated_abstract: 基于模型的规划器通过展开想象中的未来轨迹进行决策，其假设转移模型能够忠实地传播任务相关信号——这一属性很少被直接测量。在一项单种子案例研究中，我们在CARLA驾驶模拟器中考察了采用主动推理规划的循环状态空间模型（RSSM）世界模型，并发现了一个后验-先验鸿沟——后验（经观测过滤的）状态保留了障碍物信息，而想象展开状态则逐渐丢失这些信息：一个有监督的障碍物探测器在后验状态上达到AUC 0.85，但同样的探测器应用于想象的先验状态时呈现单调衰减（15步内AUC从0.85降至0.71；logit分离度下降57%）。由于探测器完全相同，这种衰减将转移模型——而非状态表征——隔离为信息瓶颈。在缺乏特权运行时坐标的情况下，避障性能降至0%，而规划器自身基于集成的认知项并未标记这一损失
tldr: 该研究揭示了世界模型的一个后验-先验鸿沟：想象展开状态会逐渐丢失任务相关的障碍物信息（而后验状态可保留），证明转移模型而非表征是信息瓶颈，导致规划器避障失败且其自身的认知项无法察觉这一信息丢失。
en_tdlr: This study identifies a posterior-prior gap in world models where imagined rollouts progressively lose task-relevant obstacle information that posterior states retain, isolating the transition model—not the representation—as the information bottleneck, causing planning failures that the planner's own ensemble-based epistemic term fails to flag.
